decisions.reason: Its home-page prominence, strong fit with the firm's core cloud messaging business, and favorable industry growth suggest results are at or above aspiration and worth continuing.
A dedicated page indicates meaningful commitment, and the service extends the firm's document workflow capabilities in a way that slack and ongoing R&D can support despite early uncertainty.

Because it was only lightly promoted and sits in a more incremental email-fax niche, it faces some risk if it falls short of aspirations, but its use of existing capabilities makes retention more likely than exit.
As a close-to-core optimization feature, it likely requires limited additional resources and can be kept while management observes whether it improves customer value in established fax processes.
Threat protection directly supports the firm's security-based value proposition, so even with limited initial promotion it is likely judged as strategically important and worth keeping.
Multi-engine virus scanning reinforces the firm's secure messaging offer and can be sustained by current organizational slack unless clear underperformance emerges.
